messages:
riley: Heads-up — I ran a quick link/image sweep in /docs/micro and hit ~12 staging images returning 403. Also one shortlink in frontmatter 410. Can someone pick rehost + a quick frontmatter ownership handoff? Need this cleared before Monday deploy.
jonathan: I can take the rehost tonight. Do you have the exact paths?
riley: Mostly under /docs/micro, examples: /docs/micro/kv-cache.png, /docs/micro/prefix-caching.png, and a handful of screenshots in /docs/micro/examples/. I pasted a tiny grep of failing URLs into the ticket.
maria: I spotted the frontmatter shortlink — micro-batching.md has a canonical pointing at short.link/old. I can claim ownership of that page and update frontmatter to canonical: /docs/micro/micro-batching/.
kevin: Pinged @maria — once you update, please add yourself to CODEOWNERS or leave a note in the PR so reviews get routed. Also consider adding the docs:micro label so the docs-sweeper doesn't flip it back. :+1:
docs-bot: scan results: 12 images returning 403; 1 shortlink 410; created ticket DOCS-2042. Suggested action: rehost images to cdn.redwood.internal and update references.
sam: Quick tip — use infra/scripts/rehost-assets.sh with `--dry-run` first. It uploads to the CDN bucket and rewrites paths for you. I can review PRs.
riley: Thanks. Jonathan — can you open a PR that rehosts the images and updates references + include the grep output in the PR description? Assign @sam and @maria for review. Add label: cherry-pick if we need a hotfix.
jonathan: Yep, starting now. Will run the script, open PR, and link DOCS-2042. ETA ~60m.
maria: If you need me to swap the canonical I'll do it in the same PR to avoid multiple deploys.
kevin: FYI — if any images are used in multiple docs, leave the old path be and add redirect mapping in cdn-mapping.json so dependent pages don't break.
jonathan: Good call — I'll scan references before rewrite.
riley: Awesome. Marking this thread resolved when PR merges. Thanks everyone!
